papers.title_en: SP-Guide: Enhancing Aerial Vision-Language Navigation with Spatial Priors
papers.authors: Haoxiang Tang, Dong Zhou, Shen Tan, Minxuan Jiang, Xitong Li
papers.evidence: 引导无人机在户外场景中执行语言目标导航
papers.tldr: 无人机航空视觉语言导航需依据局部自我中心观测，在广阔户外场景中寻找语言描述的目标。现有方法融合视角图像与全局历史地图，却主要依靠稀疏导航监督学习跨模态空间对齐。SP-Guide以空间先验跨模态编码器、指令增强解码器和目标收敛滤波器进行目标预测与终点细化。在CityNav上，其成功率超过代表性基线，且对未见环境的提升最大，说明物理依据明确的空间先验有助于稳健导航。
papers.abstract_en: Aerial vision-language navigation (AVLN) requires a UAV to reach a language-described target from partial egocentric observations while reasoning over large outdoor scenes. Existing approaches typically fuse view-centered RGB observations and globally anchored history maps as generic visual embeddings, leaving cross-modal spatial alignment to be learned from sparse navigation supervision. We present SP-Guide, a transformer- based goal-prediction framework that addresses this weakness of alignment through a Spatial Prior Cross-Modal Encoder, an Instruction Enhanced Decoder, and a Goal Convergence Filter for terminal target refinement. Experiments implemented on the CityNav benchmark show that SP-Guide improves success rate over the representative baselines, with the largest gains on unseen environments. These results indicate that physically grounded spatial priors provide an effective inductive bias for robust AVLN.

papers.title_en: RynnVLA-Latent: Scaling Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models with 3D-Grounded Latent Actions
papers.authors: Haoyu Zhao, Xingyue Zhao, Zhian Su, Bohan Hou, Yinzhou Tang, Fengyi Wang, Kehan Li, Yuming Jiang, Siteng Huang, Xin Li, Zhenyu Zeng, Mingxiu Chen, Deli Zhao, Zhongyu Li
papers.evidence: 从交互视频学习三维动作表征以训练机器人操作
papers.tldr: 机器人视觉语言动作模型的扩展受限于带动作标注示范稀缺，以及不同机器人本体控制空间不兼容。RynnVLA-Latent从多源交互视频学习连续、具三维约束的潜在动作，先预测动作片段，再适配具体机器人控制。其训练数据涵盖30.1K小时视频，生成7.4552亿个潜在动作描述；4B策略在多项仿真基准和真实操作任务中取得强表现。研究表明，潜在动作监督可将异构视频转化为可扩展的预训练信号，减少对原生机器人动作标注的依赖。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling vision-language-action (VLA) models is constrained by scarce action-labeled demonstrations and incompatible control spaces across robot embodiments. We present RynnVLA-Latent, a framework that turns heterogeneous interaction videos into scalable supervision for robot policy pretraining. At its core, RynnLAM learns continuous, 3D-grounded latent actions from visual transitions without requiring native robot controls. By combining residual future-feature prediction, camera-compensated 3D-flow supervision, and camera-motion decoupling, RynnLAM encourages representations that capture control-relevant motion rather than appearance changes alone. We apply RynnLAM to 30.1K hours of human, robot, and simulation videos, producing 745.52M latent-action descriptors. RynnVLA-Latent then learns to predict latent-action chunks from visual observations and language through flow matching, before adapting its pretrained backbone and action expert to embodiment-specific robot actions. The resulting 4B policy achieves 98.8% success on LIBERO, 84.7% on LIBERO-Plus without benchmark-specific adaptation, 51.9% average success across five VLABench tracks, and 88.6% average success on the RoboTwin 2.0 bimanual benchmark. It also achieves the highest observed success rates among the compared methods on six real-world manipulation tasks across dexterous-hand and mobile-gripper platforms. Together with representation ablations and data-scaling results, these findings demonstrate the potential of latent-action supervision for scaling robot policy learning beyond native action-labeled data.

papers.title_en: RoboAuto: Autonomous Robot Program Search through Multi-Level Physical Understanding
papers.authors: Buzhao Liu, Jianing Ye, Xiu Yuan, Yangtong Feng, Chengsong Huang, Tyler Dinh, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik, Ning Zhang, Chongjie Zhang
papers.evidence: 具身机器人在多层级场景中理解并执行操作
papers.tldr: 机器人操作中的程序搜索常依赖执行反馈，难以解释物体可供性、场景几何约束及交互成败，长程任务因此容易陷入盲目试错。RoboAuto以分层知识库组织技能和物体知识，结合场景落地与分阶段规划，并通过自主设计实验核验效果、排除物理假设的不确定性。在短程LIBERO-PRO上成功率达89.1%，在长程LIBERO-PRO及LIBERO-Plus上平均成功率超过ASPIRE两倍，也胜过若干长程真实机器人任务基线。结果表明，显式物理理解能够增强程序搜索，且知识可跨模拟器和机器人形态迁移。
papers.abstract_en: Recently, LLM-based autonomous agents have shown strong capabilities in iteratively generating, evaluating, and refining executable solutions. In robotic manipulation, Code-as-Policy lets these agents search over modular and editable robot programs. However, effective program search requires physical understanding: agents must understand how objects can be manipulated, how scene geometry constrains actions, and why interactions succeed or fail. Existing methods rely mainly on execution feedback for program refinement, often leaving these physical questions unresolved. We introduce RoboAuto, a framework for robot program search that explicitly organizes physical understanding at the object, scene, and interaction levels through three components. First, a hierarchical knowledge base combines executable skills with object-centric knowledge of affordances, spatial relations, and action effects, learned from embodied data and online task solving. Second, scene grounding connects this knowledge to the current environment by identifying relevant objects and resolving action-critical quantities. Third, multi-stage planning with self-designed experiments checks whether each stage produces its expected physical effects and actively tests competing hypotheses to resolve physical uncertainties. RoboAuto achieves superior performance across five benchmark families, attaining an 89.1% success rate on short-horizon LIBERO-PRO tasks and more than twice the mean success rate of ASPIRE on LIBERO-PRO Long and LIBERO-Plus. It also outperforms ASPIRE and $π_{0.5}$ on three challenging long-horizon real-robot tasks requiring precise manipulation. We further show that the knowledge base transfers across simulators and embodiments, and that program search performance scales with its size. Project page: https://roboauto-ai.github.io/

papers.title_en: Trace-WAM: Learning to Act via 3D Motion Prediction for World Action Models
papers.authors: Xu Hu, Changjie Wu, Linzhe Shi, Hang Zhang, Chen Yang, Lingjun Zhang, Guowen Zhang, Mu Xu, Junran Peng, Qing Li, Zhaoxiang Zhang
papers.evidence: 以三维运动预测辅助机器人操作中的感知与动作学习
papers.tldr: 机器人世界动作模型通常结合未来视频预测与动作生成，但完整场景重建可能分散对操作交互动力学的关注。Trace-WAM加入未来三维运动预测，以点对应、图像平面位移和深度变化描述物体及机器人的空间演变，并通过三分支混合Transformer联合训练视频、运动与动作。该方法在RoboCasa-GR1、LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上取得强劲表现，相较Fast-WAM在示范有限和分布偏移时优势突出。它以运动监督改善动作表征，同时保留仅基于当前观测的推理路径。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) learn representations for robot control by coupling future visual prediction with action generation. Successful manipulation depends primarily on how the robot and task-relevant objects evolve, whereas future-video prediction must also reconstruct the appearance and background of the entire scene. We therefore propose Trace-WAM, which augments video-action learning with future 3D motion prediction as an auxiliary objective. This objective supervises temporal point correspondence together with image-plane displacement and depth change, directly describing the interaction dynamics and spatial changes involved in manipulation. To this end, we adopt a three-branch Mixture-of-Transformer (Tri-MoT) architecture to jointly learn video prediction, motion prediction, and action generation. The motion expert predicts future trajectories from current visual features, allowing motion supervision to shape the representations used for action generation. Because the action expert does not consume predicted trajectories, inference retains the current-observation policy path: a single visual forward pass followed by action denoising. Experiments on RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate strong in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization, with particularly clear gains over Fast-WAM under limited demonstrations and distribution shifts.

papers.title_en: RoboCode: Learning Reusable Action Primitives for Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Xianyue Peng, Devi Amarsaikhan, Iman Soltani
papers.evidence: 学习跨任务可复用的机器人操作动作原语
papers.tldr: 机器人操作策略通常直接预测连续动作片段，却未显式利用不同任务间反复出现的短时运动模式。RoboCode从多任务动作片段学习共享的软门控原语接口，用多个原语的软组合表达动作，并在冻结接口后训练任务专属状态编码器。五项ManiSkill任务中，动作重建均方误差为0.0187，代码激活呈现跨任务复用，平均闭环成功率为75.6%，高于ACT的68.8%和扩散策略的41.6%。结果表明，可复用原语码本能兼顾操作性能与动作表示的可解释性。
papers.abstract_en: Recent robot manipulation policies commonly predict continuous action chunks directly from observations, without explicitly modeling reusable structure in the action space. However, manipulation demonstrations often contain recurring short-horizon motion patterns that are shared across tasks. We introduce \textsc{RoboCode}, which learns these patterns through a shared soft-gated primitive action interface. Rather than assigning each action chunk to a single discrete code, \textsc{RoboCode} represents it as a soft composition of multiple learned primitives, providing a flexible intermediate representation of short-horizon actions. The primitive interface is learned from action chunks pooled across multiple tasks and then frozen while task-specific state encoders are trained to map current state inputs into the shared latent space.   Experiments on five ManiSkill manipulation tasks address three questions. First, the learned primitive interface reconstructs action chunks with an average reconstruction MSE of 0.0187. Second, analysis of code activations reveals structured code reuse across tasks. Third, \textsc{RoboCode} achieves the highest or tied closed-loop success rate on all evaluated tasks, with an average success rate of 75.6%, compared with 68.8% for ACT and 41.6% for the larger Diffusion Policy baseline. These results suggest that soft-gated primitive codebooks provide an effective and interpretable intermediate action representation for robot manipulation.

papers.title_en: RAIWAY: A Large-Wheeled Bipedal Robot with Contact-Informed Blind Locomotion
papers.authors: Kyungmin Nam, Jiseong Lee, Donghyuk Choi, Jeongsoo Park, Woojin Kim, Jemin Hwangbo
papers.evidence: 机器人在不规则地形上进行接触感知移动
papers.tldr: 轮式双足机器人跨越不规则、间断地形时，运动受局部轮地接触主导；这类接触难以直接测量，也无法仅凭地形几何准确描述。研究提出接触信息驱动的盲行走控制：先在仿真中把多接触事件提炼为潜在表示，再让控制器在实机运行时依据本体感知在线推断，无需接触传感器。搭载20英寸车轮的RAIWAY通过陡坡、砾石、凸钉路面和岩石地形，并连续攀爬最高15厘米的户外台阶。与缺少该机制的基线相比，该方法在多种室内外挑战场景中表现更好，展示了接触信息迁移到实机复杂地形运动的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: We present RAIWAY, an in-house wheeled bipedal robot with 20-inch wheels, together with a contact-informed control approach for rolling locomotion across irregular and discontinuous terrain. Such locomotion is fundamentally contact-dominated, governed by local wheel--terrain interaction that is impractical to instrument directly and depends on more than terrain geometry alone. The proposed framework exploits the contact information available in simulation, distilling multi-contact events into a latent representation. At deployment, the controller infers this representation online from proprioception, requiring no contact sensing. In real-world experiments, the proposed system traverses diverse environments including steep slopes, gravel beds, studded surfaces, and rocky terrain, and demonstrates continuous ascent on the tested outdoor staircases with riser heights up to 15~cm. On our platform, the proposed controller further outperforms baselines without the contact-informed mechanism across challenging indoor and outdoor settings. The video can be found at https://youtu.be/Ch0divLg64w.

papers.title_en: RIDE-Splat: Reflection Removal for In-the-Wild Driving Environments
papers.authors: Kevin David Hayes, Alex Hanson, Allen Tu, Pranav Asthana, Matthias Zwicker, Tom Goldstein
papers.evidence: 从带反射的驾驶视频恢复干净三维场景，直接涉及场景重建方法。
papers.tldr: 驾驶视频中的挡风玻璃反射随相机移动，而道路场景具有视差，标准三维高斯泼溅因此容易把反射错误融入重建。RIDE-Splat无需干净图像、反射掩码或预训练网络，先联合学习场景几何与共享的有符号反射图像，再拟合干净三维模型。它在三个数据集的九项汇总指标上均优于基线，最高提升3.59分贝峰值信噪比，并在42项逐场景比较中赢得38项。论文还建立真实驾驶反射去除基准，推动反射干扰下的三维重建评测与应用。
papers.abstract_en: Driving video captured through a windshield violates the world-space consistency assumed by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS): the road scene exhibits parallax while cabin reflections remain attached to the camera, causing standard 3DGS to embed reflected content into the reconstructed scene. We introduce RIDE-Splat, a pipeline for reflection-free 3D reconstruction from posed driving video without clean images, reflection masks, or pretrained networks. RIDE-Splat assigns world-consistent transmission through the windshield to a 3DGS scene and the dominant camera-attached reflection to one shared, signed RGB image. It builds the clean reconstruction in two passes. First, it learns the 3D geometry and the signed reflection image, representing both added radiance and transmission attenuation. Then, it uses the reflection-removed training images to fit a clean 3DGS model. At inference, the reflection image is discarded, preserving the standard 3DGS rendering path. We also introduce the RIDE-Splat Dataset, the first 3D reconstruction benchmark for reflection removal from driving video -- with real driving scenes, physical windshield reflections in training views, and separately captured non-reflective evaluation images. Across the RIDE-Splat Dataset, XLD, and Wayve, RIDE-Splat outperforms 3DGS, DC-Gaussian, and RobustSplat on all nine aggregate metrics, improving PSNR by up to 3.59 dB and reducing LPIPS by up to 0.0876. We achieve the highest metrics in 38 out of 42 per-scene comparisons and removes windshield reflections that remain visible in the baselines while preserving the transmitted scene.

papers.title_en: TopoField: Technical Report for ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge
papers.authors: Zhiwei Chen, Zhiheng Fu, Zixu Li, Mingyu Zhang, Jiale Huang, Yupeng Hu
papers.evidence: 在室内点云中定位交互部件并输出实例掩码，属于三维场景功能分割。
papers.tldr: 室内点云功能分割要定位旋钮、按钮和插座等细小交互部件，并输出带置信度的实例掩码；点级语义概率场与离散实例评测之间存在明显落差。TopoField基于VOLT融合13次测试预测形成共识场，再从几何结构解码候选，并按类别排序。解码通过高置信核心、支持区域及图测地划分拆分含多个种子的区域。在561个实例、30个验证场景上取得28.286% AP，并获ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D挑战赛第二名，显示候选构造与排序需协同优化。
papers.abstract_en: Functional segmentation requires locating small interactive parts, such as knobs, buttons, and sockets, in indoor point clouds and returning confidence-ranked instance masks. A point-wise semantic predictor produces a continuous probability field, whereas the benchmark evaluates a discrete set of scored instances. This creates a substantial field-to-instance gap. We present TopoField, a deterministic decoder built on top of VOLT. TopoField first converts 13 test-time forward passes into a semantic consensus field, then decodes instance candidates from the consensus geometry, and finally ranks the candidates in a class-aware manner. The augmentation stage retains the processed-point identity of every fragment prediction, accumulates probabilities in a common point array, normalizes by coverage count, and fuses the resulting caches. The decoding stage separates high-confidence cores from broader support regions, constructs a symmetric radius-pruned point graph, and uses a multi-source graph-geodesic partition to split support regions that contain multiple seeds. On 561 ground-truth instances across 30 validation scenes, an IoU-0.5-valid candidate exists for 67.2% of instances, and top-1 coverage is 20.0%. These complementary measurements motivate joint attention to candidate construction and ranking. TopoField achieves 28.286% AP, 41.383% AP50, and 47.558% AP25. TopoField achieved second place on the ECCV 2026 SceneFun3D Challenge.

papers.title_en: DEQ-Stereo: Deep Euilibrium Video Stereo Matching via Adaptive Convergence
papers.authors: Kiljoon Han, Kyumin Hwang, Wonheok Choi, Jeonghoon Kim, Sunghoom Im
papers.evidence: 改进视频立体匹配这一直接估计场景深度几何的任务。
papers.tldr: 迭代细化虽能提升立体匹配精度，但固定更新计划带来较高计算成本，视频场景还面临速度与精度难以兼顾的问题。DEQ-Stereo将细化过程改写为隐式固定点求解，不再预设迭代步数，并在满足收敛时自适应停止。模型以ConvSGU促进帧内快速稳定收敛，再通过TST将已收敛的隐藏状态传给下一帧，无需显式姿态或图像变形先验。实验表明其达到领先性能并改善精度与延迟权衡，为高效视频立体匹配提供新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Iterative refinement models have significantly improved stereo matching accuracy, but their rigid, fixed update schedules incur heavy computational costs and a strict trade-off between speed and accuracy. This challenge is magnified in video streams, where traditional online methods resort to reducing feature channels or relying on expensive temporal warping. To address this, we propose \textbf{DEQ-Stereo}, a novel video stereo matching framework based on the Deep Equilibrium (DEQ) paradigm. Instead of unrolling a fixed number of iterations, DEQ-Stereo reformulates the refinement as an implicit fixed-point problem, adaptively terminating once convergence is met. To ensure fast and stable intra-frame convergence, we introduce the \textbf{Convolutional Simplified Gated Unit (ConvSGU)}, which eliminates unnecessary non-linearities by modeling the latent state as a gated, element-wise sum of inputs. Furthermore, to exploit cross-frame temporal coherence, we propose \textbf{Temporal State Transfer (TST)}, a warm-start strategy that propagates the converged hidden state to the next frame without requiring explicit pose or warping priors. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DEQ-Stereo delivers state-of-the-art performance with a superior accuracy-to-latency trade-off.

papers.title_en: PhysAg3D: Bridging 3D Generative and Agentic Models for High-Fidelity and Physically-Interactive Assets
papers.authors: Bi'an Du, Fanpeng Meng, Jiemin Fang, Chen Yang, Pufan Li, Daizong Liu, Qi Tian, Wei Hu
papers.evidence: 从单图生成网格并表达物体交互机制
papers.tldr: 从单张图像生成可交互三维资产，不仅要还原外观与几何，还需推断物体部件及可信的运动、变形方式。PhysAg3D先由视觉语言智能体提出语义部件、交互候选和物理先验，再结合三维生成模型生成带纹理的整体网格，并用分层交互表示连接先验、机构与表面。智能体借助几何和物理工具构建关节、可变形区域及表面绑定，并依据渲染结果与执行测量，在固定预算内定向修订。实验显示其能生成细节丰富、图像对齐且交互合理的刚性或柔性资产，验证了保留生成几何并进行受控迭代的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Generating interactive 3D assets from a single image requires realistic appearance, fidelity to the depicted object, and plausible physical behavior. Yet detailed geometry alone does not determine how an object should move or deform. We introduce PhysAg3D, which couples 3D generative models with agentic reasoning and tool use. A vision-language agent first infers semantic parts, candidate interactions, and physical priors from the image; a 3D generator then produces a textured whole-object mesh from the same image. A hierarchical interaction representation links these revisable priors to mechanisms and the generated surfaces they control, organizing interaction construction and refinement. Guided by this representation and observations of the mesh, the agent uses geometric and physical tools to construct parts, joints, deformable regions, and surface bindings while retaining useful generated geometry and materials. Rendered interactions and execution measurements guide targeted revisions within a fixed budget. The framework accommodates both rigid articulation and compliant deformation. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on real photographs and external benchmarks demonstrate detailed, image-aligned assets with plausible interactions. Ablations support bounded refinement and source-surface preservation. Project Page: supra-3d.github.io/PhysAg3D.

papers.title_en: MLLM-GS: Multimodal Large Language Model Prior-Guided Fast Novel View Synthesis in Extreme Environments
papers.authors: Zhiliang Wu, Xinye Zheng, Kun Li, Fei Wang, Hao Guo, Yanyan Wei, Guanghui Yue, Beier Zhu, Wei Zhou, Xun Yang
papers.evidence: 从多视图观测重建三维场景并生成新视角图像，契合表面及场景重建研究。
papers.tldr: 极端环境中的雾、雨等严重退化会破坏多视图观测，使新视角合成难以兼顾画质、泛化能力与计算效率。MLLM-GS借助冻结的多模态大语言模型视觉先验增强退化视图，并以轻量校正网络缓解生成结果的像素错位和颜色偏差，再用少量配对清晰视图监督增强过程。增强视图作为伪真值用于后续三维高斯重建，且通过优化光栅化、高斯内存布局和参数更新降低开销。实验显示，该方法适用于多种严重退化，取得高质量合成并显著减少重建时间和内存，为极端环境下的实用新视角合成提供了更高效的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in degraded scenes aims to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view observations affected by various degradations, and to generate clear and photorealistic images at unseen viewpoints. Despite recent advances, existing methods often rely on degradation-specific models, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments. Generative models provide rich visual priors, but their outputs often suffer from pixel misalignment and color deviations, which can propagate into the reconstructed 3D scene and compromise reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the high computational and memory costs of 3D reconstruction hinder the practical application of NVS in extreme environments. To this end, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments. MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction. The former leverages the rich visual priors of a frozen MLLM to enhance views under different severe degradations and introduces a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel shifts and color distortions in MLLM outputs. With supervision from only a few paired clean views, this branch produces reliable enhanced views for all degraded observations, providing pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction. The latter improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, Gaussian memory layout, and parameter updates, reducing redundant computation, memory-access overhead, and optimization costs. Extensive experiments on multiple degraded scenes demonstrate that MLLM-GS effectively handles various severe degradations and achieves high-quality NVS with significantly lower reconstruction time and memory consumption. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/MLLM-GS

papers.title_en: Robust Single-Parameter Point Cloud Registration using Truncated Lp Functions
papers.authors: Seong Hun Lee, Patrick Vandewalle, Javier Civera
papers.evidence: 稳健点云配准可作为扫描几何处理流程的对齐环节
papers.tldr: 真实场景中的三维特征匹配往往含有高比例离群点，使点云配准容易受到错误对应关系干扰。论文提出TLP，使用不同指数的截断Lp函数，为对应关系排序、假设选择和模型精炼提供鲁棒机制，并以GPU并行快速评估假设。该方法只需一个可调参数，处理数千条对应关系平均不到一秒。公开基准结果表明，TLP优于现有单参数方法，并在四个数据集中的三个上胜过两种常用多参数方法，为兼顾精度、效率与易用性提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel method for robust point cloud registration with only one tunable parameter. Our method, dubbed TLP, uses truncated $L_p$ functions with different values of $p$ to assign priority scores to correspondences, select the hypothesis, and refine the final model. By leveraging the robustness of truncated functions, TLP effectively handles the high outlier rates commonly encountered in real-world 3D feature matching. We also exploit GPU parallelization to evaluate hypotheses efficiently, enabling registration from thousands of correspondences in under a second on average. With only one tunable parameter, our method offers greater practicality than multi-parameter methods that require dataset-specific tuning of several parameters. Evaluations on public benchmark datasets demonstrate that TLP achieves higher accuracy than state-of-the-art single-parameter methods. Furthermore, it outperforms two widely used multi-parameter methods on three of the four evaluated datasets while maintaining competitive runtime.

papers.title_en: Texture Consolidation of Generated Multi-View Renderings
papers.authors: Hongyi Liu, Yifan Wang, Vladimir G. Kim, Misha Kazhdan
papers.evidence: 借助三角网格融合多视角渲染纹理
papers.tldr: 现代生成模型能够生成逼真的多视图渲染，但不同视角之间往往缺乏外观一致性，使结果难以直接转化为网格纹理。本文提出一套将稀疏渲染整合为单张纹理的流程：先反投影到纹理空间并估计颜色置信度，再通过网格光流对齐视图，最后进行梯度域拼接融合。该流程产出统一、连贯的纹理，并在配准和融合中利用置信度。它将多视图图像生成与几何处理衔接起来，为生成内容进入纹理制作流程提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: We present a system for consolidating a sparse set of multi-view renderings into a single coherent texture image, providing a framework for integrating generative models for image generation within the geometry-processing pipeline. Given a texture-atlased triangle mesh and a set of renderings with associated camera parameters, we generate the texture image by: (1) back-projecting the renderings onto the mesh to obtain texture images with normalized colors and confidences; (2) solving for flow-fields on the mesh that align the colors to each other, taking into account the associated confidences; and (3) fusing the registered colors into a single texture image using gradient-domain stitching, again incorporating confidences. Our approach complements existing techniques for multi-view image generation, leveraging mesh-based optical flow and texture-space stitching. In doing so it addresses the challenge that while modern image generation pipelines generate highly convincing renderings, they struggle to produce renderings that are consistent across views. Code is available at https://github.com/hliuw/TextureConsolidation.

papers.title_en: SSQA: Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention for Hierarchical Modeling in Perception Tasks
papers.authors: Yufan Chen, Arnav Bali, Angela Liu, Laura Zheng, Ming C. Lin
papers.evidence: 提出面向导航感知任务的层级建模注意力，利用场景空间结构组织信息。
papers.tldr: 无人机与自动驾驶感知中的天空、地形、道路及障碍物具有明显的轴向层次结构，通用图像注意力未必充分利用这种先验，且标准注意力计算开销随令牌数平方增长。论文提出兄弟选择四叉树注意力（SSQA），将图像令牌组织为完整四叉树，并在层级结构中选择性建模兄弟节点关系。作者通过复杂度分析给出线性时间特征建模保证，并与 Mamba 2、四叉树注意力等比较推理速度。多项任务实验显示，SSQA 的效果至少不逊于对比方法、部分场景更优，同时计算成本显著更低，适合结构化感知任务。
papers.abstract_en: Perception tasks for navigation in robotics, including aerial platforms such as drones and autonomous driving systems, are inherently structured. Drone-mounted cameras typically capture sky above, terrain below, and obstacles or man-made structures in between, while driving data often contains organized road layouts, lane markings, and surrounding agents. Motivated by these axis-aligned structural priors, we note that such information is typically more structured than in generic image tasks. We hypothesize that processing information in a quadtree-esque manner can not only model features effectively in a hierarchical manner, but also offers an efficient linear-time alternative to vanilla attention mechanisms, which run in quadratic time. In this paper, we propose Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention (SSQA), which models image tokens hierarchically as a structured, full quadtree. We show analytical complexity analysis that guarantees linear-time feature modeling, in addition to empirical experiments comparing inference speeds with other popular modeling approaches, such as Mamba 2 and Quadtree Attention. Our results, benchmarked across several tasks, show that we achieve results at least as good, if not notably better, as others at a fraction of the computational costs.
